newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers edge up, Med falls on average $2.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers edge up, Med falls on average $2.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged higher on Wednesday in line with slight barge market strength, while prices in southern Europe fell, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $83/$85 fob, as the barge market bounced slightly from its $4 fall on Tuesday.
Demand remained low with many shipowners convinced prices would resume their downward course later this week.
Hamburg prices were also slightly firmer as supplies from two local majors tightened. Quotes for 380 CST were at around $92/$95 fob.
One supplier said the market for bitumen was improving and that the majors were reducing their supplies of fuel oil accordingly.
Mediterranean prices mostly fell by around $2 as benchmark quotes weakened. The expectation of further falls left most ports with normal or below normal activity.
Saudi Aramco raised its price for diesel in the Red Sea by $3 to $191 effective from Thursday. All other prices were stable.
